title: Commercial Account Executive
description:
As an Account Executive (AE) on our Commercial Sales team, you will assist in Datadog’s overall business growth by strategically engaging and closing net-new customers across small to midsize markets. Sellers follow a well-defined methodology, collaborate with internal stakeholders, identify the customer's unique needs, and clearly convey the value of the Datadog product. AEs have the opportunity to grow their careers in Sales and continue contributing to Datadog team success.
 At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.
 What You’ll Do:
 Focus on net-new logo acquisition via outbound activity
 Become a Datadog expert through continued product and sales trainings
 Manage the full sales cycle, including technical demonstrations and negotiation
 Collaborate with Sales Development Representatives to drive top of funnel activity
 Strategically prospect into Chief Technology Officers, Engineering/IT Leaders, and technical end-users
 Who You Are:
 Curious, driven, and motivated as a sales person
 Creative in how you map and break into accounts
 Able to learn from feedback and champion a growth mindset
 Comfortable operating in a highly technical, fast paced environment
 Experienced in carrying quota, with a proven track record of success
 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your experience, we encourage you to apply.
 Benefits and Growth:
 High income earning opportunities based on self performance
 New hire stock equity (RSU) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
 Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
 Sales training in MEDDIC and Command of the Message

title: Sales Intern
description:

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
 This is a 12-week internship during summer 2026.
 As a Sales, Trading, and Prime (STP) Intern, you'll join the Institutional team and rotate through Sales, Account Management, Execution Services, Financing, Solutions Architecture, and Research. This team engages with the world's most sophisticated institutions to introduce new products, provide market color, devise financing solutions, and deliver client feedback that informs product development. You'll come away with a unique understanding of our clients' needs and how Coinbase builds relationships and trust through outstanding service and product capabilities.
 What you'll do:
 Rotate across STP functions including Sales, Account Management, Execution Services, Financing, Solutions Architecture, and Research to build a comprehensive view of institutional client needs
 Analyze data for trends and opportunities, producing competitor analysis and market commentary that inform client engagement strategies
 Create pitchbooks and outreach materials for client presentations and high-value prospect engagement
 Triage and follow up with inbound leads to qualify sales opportunities, tracking progress across product campaigns
 Research and propose process improvements that grow and strengthen the STP business

title: Customer Success Manager, Beneficial Deployments - Life Sciences
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role
 Join Anthropic as a Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's initiatives in Life Sciences. As a Customer Success Manager for Life Sciences, you’ll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the world's leading organizations working to accelerate scientific discovery. You will help them harness the full potential of Claude's capabilities across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude Science to accelerate their scientific work.
 This is a hybrid role that blends deep 1:1 account management with scaled, one-to-many programs. You'll own a portfolio of named strategic accounts, such as research institutes, academic medical centers, scientific foundations, and mission-driven biotech, where you'll build genuine partnerships grounded in a deep understanding of their research mission, scientific objectives, programmatic goals, and technical capacity. You will help these organizations scale their usage effectively drive model and use case optimization, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. Alongside that portfolio, you'll design and run a handful of one-to-many engagement programs, including webinars, hackathons, cohort-based enablement, and researcher communities, that extend Claude's impact across the broader life sciences ecosystem well beyond any single partner relationship.
